note: A 16:9 video, so every graphic is horizontal. The script asks for the hook text, one name super and four highlight lines, then the end card. Questions are heard and captioned, not drawn as cards.

mg.title: Hook question

text.main: What do you wish every donor understood?

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “What do you wish every donor understood?” Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:04. Top of the frame.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:15 for 3 s, lower left: “Lucinda Patterson” / Chief Financial Officer, CASS
mg.use: Put it on at 00:15 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <Chief Financial Officer, CASS> under the name.

mg.title: Mission-driven

text.main: mission-driven, more so than driven just to make a profit

mg.cue: Highlight text in the top band at 00:36 for 3 s: “mission-driven, more so than driven just to make a profit”
mg.use: Put it on when she says mission-driven, about 00:36, for 3 s. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Clients come first
mg.cue: Highlight text in the top band at 01:56 for 3 s: “Clients come first.”
mg.use: Put it on as she says it, about 01:56, for 3 s. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Not frivolously
mg.cue: Highlight text in the top band at 02:26 for 3 s: “It's not being used frivolously.”
mg.use: Put it on as she says it, about 02:26, for 3 s. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: It's fulfilling
mg.cue: Highlight text in the top band at 02:43 for 2 s: “It's fulfilling.”
mg.use: Put it on as she says it, at 02:43, for 2 s. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo file is in the repo yet (endcards/index.json has no CASS entry). The CASS name is typed in CASS navy until the logo file is added to endcards/cass/. Wording from the client file: cassaz.org.
mg.use: After her last line at 02:54. Hold it to the end. Music fades out over 1 s.
